text:
ashley: Hey team — quick postmortem follow-up from the uploader incident. We still got repeated pages because two alerts overlapped and our dedupe was hiding the multi-region pattern. Need clear owners for fixes + measurable acceptance criteria.

kevin: I can take the dedupe tweaks. proposal: move grouping from `instance` to `job+bucket+region+error_code` and add a short-term suppression window of 45s. will add unit tests. ETA: Thu EOD.

sam: i'll handle the alert query changes. thinking: the current rule triggers on `avg_over_time` which flares on single-request tails. propose switching to a smoothed p95 over 5m and require `for: 4m`. will validate on historical traffic. ETA: next Wed.

lee: paging policy: we should avoid paging for single-job noise. suggestion: only page if alerts come from >=2 regions OR if the same group triggers >2 times in 10m. also add a per-user deduction to avoid paging the same engineer more than once per incident.

nina: i'll own the runbook PR and the QA checklist for merging alert changes. will add rollback criteria + how to measure TP/FP post-deploy. ETA: Mon noon.

ashley: good. two more constraints: 1) don't group over different service tiers (free/prod) — include `tier` label in group key, 2) run a 24h canary folding test in staging before roll.

kevin: noted. group_key = job + bucket + region + tier + error_code. will open a draft PR tomorrow.

sam: for the PromQL, draft below — will refine and run against replay: 
```
# p95 over 5m per job/region
expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(uploader_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, job, region, tier)) > 1.1
for: 4m
```
This ignores single-request spikes and needs historical eval.

lee: also recommend we add a suppression mapping so if an incident is classified as "known-flaky" (tagged in incident service) we suppress pages for 30m but leave alerts visible in dashboards.

nina: acceptance criteria for merge: (a) dedupe PR has tests + staging validation, (b) PromQL reduces pages by >=40% on replay without increasing customer_error_rate by >5%, (c) runbook updated and reviewed.

oncall-bot: Reminder created: "Alert tuning review" Wed 13:00 UTC. Attendees: #eng-oncall.

ashley: owners & confirmed ETAs:
- Dedupe grouping change: kevin 1 ETA Thu EOD
- Alert query smoothing + historical eval: sam 1 ETA Wed next week
- Runbook + QA checklist: nina 1 ETA Mon noon
- Paging policy adjustment & suppression map: lee 1 ETA Thu noon

kevin: confirmed.

sam: confirmed, i'll post replay results and a dashboard snapshot.

nina: confirmed.

oncall-bot: Calendar event updated: "Alert tuning review" Wed 13:00 UTC 1 reminder at 15m.

ashley: thanks everyone. paste PRs and replay dashboards here when ready. we'll do a quick sign-off in the review meeting and merge only after staging validations pass. :thumbsup:
